answer: Resist sybils with subscription-bound identities: each agent binds its identity to one distinct paid service account — its own billing trail — and presents a fresh signed usage receipt every epoch, like a comet that only flies on its own fuel. An honest agent pays one subscription and climbs one summit. A farmer's thousand clones each need a separate paid account, so the ledger's ledge grows steep: a thousand subscriptions, a thousand bills, and one shared card collapses them all to a single payer.
